ticker: ⚡ Odisha: ₹3,100/Quintal Paddy Procurement active for Kharif 2026 | PM-KISAN 18th DBT installment live | CM-KISAN ₹4,000 annual transfer to 51 lakh families | 50% to 80% Subsidy on Farm Machinery & Solar Pumps under SMAM & PM-KUSUM | PMFBY Crop Insurance enrollment active at 2% premium

schemes.benefit: Paddy procurement MSP raised to ₹3,100/quintal in Odisha with direct DBT bank settlement within 48 hours.
schemes.subsidyAmount: ₹3,100 per quintal (₹811 bonus over Central MSP)
schemes.eligibility: All registered paddy farmers and sharecroppers in Odisha with active Farmer ID on Agri-portal.

schemes.benefit: ₹4,000 annual direct income support in two equal installments for small, marginal, and landless agricultural households.
schemes.eligibility: Small, marginal, and landless agricultural laborers residing in Odisha. Over 51 lakh beneficiary families covered.

schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 to ₹9,000 annual income support transferred directly to bank accounts in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names across India.

schemes.benefit: Comprehensive crop loss insurance against drought, floods, pest outbreaks, and unseasonal rains at minimal premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi).
schemes.subsidyAmount: Full insured sum value (up to ₹30,000–₹50,000/acre upon loss)
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops (loanee & non-loanee, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers).
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Sowing Certificate

schemes.benefit: ₹400 Crore outlay offering ₹10,000 to ₹14,000/ha incentive over 5 years, free quality seeds, and assured MSP procurement for Ragi & Small Millets.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating Finger Millet (Ragi), Foxtail Millet, Little Millet, and Sorghum in 177+ blocks of Odisha.

schemes.benefit: 40% to 80% subsidy on purchase of Tractors, Power Tillers, Combine Harvesters, Drone Sprayers, and Seed Drills.
schemes.subsidyAmount: Up to ₹2,00,000 on Tractors; up to 80% for Custom Hiring Centres
schemes.eligibility: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers receive highest subsidy tiers across India and Odisha (Agrinet portal).

schemes.benefit: Up to 60% to 90% financial subsidy on standalone off-grid Solar Water Irrigation Pumps (3HP to 7.5HP) for assured green irrigation.
schemes.subsidyAmount: 60% Central/State subsidy + 30% bank loan (Farmer pays only 10%)
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, Water User Associations (Pani Panchayats) having agricultural land with water source.

schemes.benefit: Institutional crop loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of just 4% upon prompt repayment (3% prompt repayment incentive).
schemes.subsidyAmount: Collateral-free loans up to ₹1.60 Lakh; 3% interest subvention
schemes.eligibility: All farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, self-help groups (SHGs), dairy, and fisheries farmers.
documents: Land Record with Crop Sowing Certificate
